observation_summary: The method appendFixedWidthPadRight throws a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when the input string length is greater than the specified width, because it attempts to copy the entire string into a buffer that only has space for the specified width.
reasoning_summary: The bug is an incorrect implementation of the string truncation logic. When the string length exceeds the target width, the code should only copy 'width' characters, but it was incorrectly copying 'strLen' characters. This is a procedural error in the computation logic (the range of characters to copy), which is best classified as Algorithm/Method.

The stack trace shows a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException occurring at the line where the string is copied into the buffer.
